common.tagline: Your companion for barangay health work.

home.heading: Welcome to BHW Connect
home.body: This is the foundation shell for Phase 1. Features roll out one increment at a time.

privacy.heading: Privacy Notice
privacy.body: The full Data Privacy Act notice ships with the consent flow in a later increment.

login.heading: Log in
login.body: Enter the username and password your admin gave you.
login.lockedMessage: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
login.inactiveMessage: This account isn't active. Contact your barangay admin.
login.timeoutNotice: You were signed out after a period of inactivity. Please log in again.
login.blockedNotice: This account is no longer active. Contact your barangay admin.
login.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

changePassword.heading: Choose a new password
changePassword.body: This is a temporary password. Set a new one to continue — at least 8 characters, no need for symbols or numbers.
changePassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
changePassword.tooCommon: That password is too easy to guess. Please choose another.
changePassword.genericError: Couldn't save your new password. Please try again.

consent.heading: Privacy Notice & Consent
consent.intro: Before you continue, please review how BHW Connect handles your data.
consent.bodyWhat: We collect your name, contact details, barangay assignment, and your Chat Guide questions so the app can work for you and your barangay.
consent.bodyWhy: This data is used to run your account, support your barangay health work, and improve the Chat Guide's answers.
consent.bodyRetention: Chat messages and usage data are kept for up to 24 months; account and audit records are kept longer as required by law.
consent.bodyRights: You have the right to ask your admin for a copy of your data or to have your account deactivated and anonymized.
consent.genericError: Couldn't record your consent. Please try again.

authHome.heading: Welcome, {name}!
authHome.body: You're logged in to BHW Connect.
